summary: Small plane crashed near the junction of the Medano Pass primitive road and Medano Lake Road in Great Sand Dunes National Park; pilot and one of two passengers killed, second passenger hospitalized. AVSAR assisted Saguache County SAR and the National Park Service with trailhead security and road control until FAA arrived; Flight for Life helicopters landed near the crash site, eliminating the need for a carry-out.
location: Medano Lake area, Great Sand Dunes National Park
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR (assist to Saguache County SAR / National Park Service)
notes: AVSAR mission spanned 2013-06-08 to 2013-06-09. NPS morning report (2013-07-02 entry) confirms the pilot and one passenger were killed and the second passenger was hospitalized; NTSB/FAA investigated.
